project_identity.purpose: Instant real-time ephemeral cross-device clipboard & text sharing web application (CopyPaste.me enhanced alternative).

client.description: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS SPA with class-based dual-theme engine and WebSockets client.
sub_sections: src/components/Navbar.jsx (Responsive header with theme toggle and navigation)
src/components/Footer.jsx (Ecosystem footer with legal suite, founder attribution, and official domain emails)
src/pages/Landing.jsx (Hero room generator, 4-step user guide, use cases, shortcuts, and FAQ accordion)
src/pages/Room.jsx (Real-time live clipboard room with QR code pairing, active user counter, and one-touch copy)
src/pages/About.jsx (Authoritative bilingual brand story and privacy-first architecture)
src/pages/Contact.jsx (Support desk, bug bounty form, and official inquiry routing)
src/pages/Privacy.jsx (Zero-log RAM ephemeral memory privacy policy)
